Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland is a regional healthcare cluster operating within [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] in Denmark. It is actively monitored in the national clinical quality databases and annual reports concerning the treatment and management of [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]], published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut.

In the context of national quality standards, Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland has faced challenges in meeting specific clinical benchmarks. Notably, it was identified as one of the health clusters that failed to meet the national standard of 90% for Indicator 1, which measures the timely initiation of anticoagulation therapy for newly diagnosed patients, achieving a result of 87.9% [^src1]. Furthermore, it was highlighted alongside [[klynge-syd|Klynge SYD]], [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]], and [[goedstrupklyngen|Gødstrupklyngen]] as one of only four clusters that did not meet the standard for [[indikator-4a3|Indikator 4a3]], which tracks long-term (5-year) treatment coverage [^src4].

The cluster's performance is tracked across a wide array of clinical indicators. These include short- and long-term anticoagulation treatment coverage [^src2], [^src3], annual kidney function monitoring for patients on DOACs, and the incidence of ischemic stroke (apopleksi) [^src5]. The national map of stroke incidence ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]) at the health cluster level includes Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland, with incidence rates distributed across various intervals [^src5]. Additional monitored outcomes for the cluster encompass severe bleeding incidents within one year of diagnosis [^src7], heart failure development [^src8], mortality rates [^src6], and waiting times for treatment initiation [^src11]. Data for these metrics is consistently reported in both the 2024 and 2025 editions of the national reports, reflecting its ongoing role in the regional and national quality improvement strategy for cardiovascular care [^src9], [^src10], [^src12].
